command.description: The command object. Must include a string `op` field.

tools.name: add_video_layer
tools.description: Add a layer to the VX scene and return its id. Kinds: video, image, camera, text, drawing, model3d, adjustment (adjustment = full-canvas FX only; master is a managed singleton and cannot be added). After adding, set its source/props with update_video_layer and stack FX with add_video_fx.

kind.description: Layer kind. 'shader' is a user-GLSL fragment layer — write its source with video_command {op:'setShaderSource'}.

insertAt.description: Data-index to insert at (default: top of stack).

sourcePath.description: Absolute file path to image/video/model media to load into the new layer (no file picker). Bytes are read natively and handed to the WebView as a blob. Large videos are bounded by maxBytes.

maxBytes.description: Max bytes to read for sourcePath (default ~16MB; raise for video, e.g. 50000000).

tools.name: update_video_layer
tools.description: Update a layer's common props and/or kind-specific fields. transform is merged (partial) against the current transform; other fields replace. Common: opacity (0..1), blendMode (normal|add|multiply|screen), enabled, name, transform {x,y(0..1),scale,rotation(rad),anchor}. Kind-specific via `fields`: text layers {text,fontSize,fontWeight,color,align,lineHeight}; image/video/model3d {sourcePath,fit}; camera {deviceId,mirror,fit}; drawing {paintColor,paintWidth}; model3d {lightingMode,lightIntensity,rotateRateX/Y/Z,...}. Use get_video_state to see a layer's current fields.

fields.description: Kind-specific fields (text, sourcePath, fit, fontSize, color, …).

tools.name: set_video_layer_source
tools.description: Load image/video/model media into an existing VX layer from a file path — the headless equivalent of the file picker. Reads bytes natively and assigns a blob the layer renders. PAM's window must be open (VX renders in the WebView). Large videos: raise maxBytes.

sourcePath.description: Absolute path to the media file.

maxBytes.description: Max bytes to read (default ~16MB; raise for video).

tools.name: remove_video_layer
tools.description: Remove a layer (and its FX + bindings). The master layer cannot be removed.

tools.name: apply_video_layout
tools.description: Arrange the spatial layers with a layout preset: centered (stacked), grid, columns, rows, or focus (one large + thumbnail strip). adjustment and master layers are untouched.

tools.name: add_video_fx
tools.description: Append an FX to a layer's chain (target='layer', needs layerId) or to the output/global chain (target='output'), and return the new id. Per-layer FX: hueRotate, glow, audioReact, vibration, chromaticAberration, pixelate, rgbShift, mirror, trails(drawing/text), beam(drawing/text), shake, rolls, barrelBlur, edge, halftone, patches, brightnessContrast, lines, feedback, warp, datamosh, slicer, polarSlitScan, cellVoronoi, spectralZones, paletteLut, asciiDither, pixelSort, cameraShake, blur, cymatics, lineJitter, crt, vhs. Output FX: lines, barrelBlur, brightnessContrast, edge, glow, shake, rgbShift, halftone, mirror, patches, pixelate, rolls, feedback, warp, datamosh, slicer, positionXY, speed, cellVoronoi, polarSlitScan, spectralZones, audioReact. FX params seed from registry defaults; override via `params`. Use set_video_fx to tweak afterwards.

fxType.description: FX id (see the per-layer / output id lists).

beforeFxId.description: Insert before this fx id instead of appending (layer target only).

tools.name: set_video_fx
tools.description: Set FX params / enabled / strength on a per-layer FX (target='layer', needs layerId + fxId) or an output FX (target='output', needs instanceId, or fxId to auto-create). Pass a single {param,value}, multiple {params}, `enabled`, and/or `strength` (output only). Get current ids/params from get_video_state.

fxId.description: Layer fx id, or output fxId (auto-creates the output fx).

instanceId.description: target='output': the output fx instance id.

strength.description: Output FX wet strength (output target only).

tools.name: remove_video_fx
tools.description: Remove an FX from a layer chain (target='layer' + layerId + fxId) or the output chain (target='output' + instanceId).

fxId.description: target='layer': fx id on the layer.

tools.name: bind_video_param
tools.description: Bind a per-layer FX param or layer field to an audio/transport source so it reacts to the music. Omit fxId (or pass '') to target a layer field: transform.x, transform.y, transform.scale, transform.rotation, opacity, hue, brightness, contrast, saturation, playbackRate, fontSize, pulseAmount, or model3d fields. Pass fxId to target an FX param (param key from that FX). Pass `source` as a sourceKey string: `g:<id>` global (level, bandLow, bandMid, bandHigh, transient, transientLow, transientMid, transientHigh, bpm, spectralCentroid, spectralFlux, stereoWidth, varyActivity, phraseLevel, phraseBass, looperBus, masterOnsetLow/Mid/High, masterStereoWidth, masterPanScalar, masterFullMix, masterCompressorGR, sidechainLevel, sidechainEnv); `t:<phase>` transport (beat, bar, phrase); `c:<cell>:<field>` per-cell (level, envFollow, pulse, onset, spectrumPeak, spectrumCentroid, pitch, postFaderL/R, samplerRMSL/R, synthRMS, beatPosition, activeRetriggers, grainActivity, grainPos, grainSpread, grainPitch, grainPitchSpread, grainReverseRatio); `l:<track>:level` looper; `lf:<lfo>:rate|phase` LFO; `p:<paramId>` any DAW param (e.g. p:macro_1). Or a structured object e.g. {kind:'cell',cellIndex:1,field:'onset'}. amount is -1..1; curve linear|exp|expInverse|bipolar; mode additive|replace|multiply|centered; impulse off|pulse|latch (one-shot on threshold crossing). attack/release default per-source if omitted.

paramKey.description: FX param key, or layer field (e.g. transform.scale, opacity).

fxId.description: FX instance id; omit/'' for a layer-field target.

tools.name: set_video_settings
tools.description: Set global VX render/sync settings: syncMode (off|beat-sync|beat-match), loopBars, aspectRatio (auto|16:9|4:3|1:1|stretch), renderQuality (low|medium|high), designAspect (w/h number or null), letterboxColor / canvasColor (#hex), the mod-matrix master enable, VX-variation follow-audio, and VX bar-sync (queue slot loads on the next bar boundary while playing). resetWorkspace clears the scene (preserves the master layer).

vxVariationFollowAudio.description: VX variation slots follow audio variation switches (default true).

vxBarSyncEnabled.description: Queue VX-local slot loads on the next bar-sync boundary while the transport plays.

vxBarSyncIntervalBars.description: VX bar-sync interval in bars (-1 = longest-pattern sentinel).

activeCell.description: Deprecated/no-op: VX is a single global scene (no per-cell video).

resetWorkspace.description: If true, clear the whole scene first.

tools.name: vx_variation
tools.description: Manage the 8 VX (visual) variation slots — the visual siblings of the audio variation slots (save_variation / load_variation). 'save' snapshots the live VX scene into a slot; 'load' recalls one (an empty slot moves the index but keeps the current visuals); 'clear' empties a slot; 'fill' saves 8 randomized scene variations into all slots. With vxVariationFollowAudio on (default), audio variation switches — including Song Mode section changes — recall the matching VX slot automatically, so saving VX slots alongside audio slots gives every song section its own visuals (pin a different slot per section via song_mode assignVx). WebView-routed: PAM's window must be OPEN. Verify via get_video_state → vxVariations / currentVxVariation.

index.description: Slot index 0-7 (required for save/load/clear; ignored for fill).

tools.name: reset_cell
tools.description: Reset all parameters of a single cell to their default values and remove any envelopes targeting this cell. Does not touch other cells.

tools.name: copy_cell
tools.description: Copy all parameters and modulation from one cell to another. Overwrites the target cell's settings.

tools.name: clear_modulations
tools.description: Remove all LFO, envelope, and vary modulation links targeting a cell's parameters (or originating from that cell, for envelopes/vary). Useful for starting fresh on a cell.

tools.name: reset_patterns
tools.description: Clear all sequencer lanes (note, pitch, slice, stretch) for a single PAM/Cell1 sampler cell.

tools.name: update_effect_config
tools.description: Toggle cell effects on/off (filter, delay, crusher, flanger, eq, eq8, fdn, gate, compressor, panner, gain, vocoder, limiter, qverb, wavefold, resonator). wavefold and resonator exist on MFX only. Uses the lighter KV path that does not rebuild the audio graph. Pass 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

tools.name: set_mfx_routing
tools.description:
Read or replace the MFX cable patch — the graph that decides which cell feeds which. MFX-only; on PAM/Cell1 this returns a product error.

Ports: 'input' (the host's audio in) and 'sidechain' are sources; 'output' is the destination; 'cellN' is both. A self-edge cellN→cellN is a feedback loop, and input→output is a direct dry path. Duplicate cables are dropped.

A plain serial chain on 4 cells is input→cell1, cell1→cell2, cell2→cell3, cell3→cell4, cell4→output. Parallel is input→each cell plus each cell→output.

'set' REPLACES the whole patch, so send the full cable list. Per-cable levels live in mfx_edge_gains and are left alone; a new cable takes the graph's own default (unity forward, 0.5 on a back or self edge). Re-patching rebuilds the audio graph, like reordering FX.

op.description: 'get' reads the current cables; 'set' replaces them.

edges.description: Full cable list for 'set'. An empty array clears the patch (silence).

from.description: Source port: 'input', 'sidechain', or 'cellN'. 'output' is a destination only.

to.description: Destination port: 'output' or 'cellN'. 'input'/'sidechain' are sources only.

tools.name: update_cell_config
tools.description: Update cell-level configuration properties like polyphony, MIDI settings, varispeed, and modulation latch. These are KV-only properties that don't appear in the parameter manifest. Uses a lightweight KV path without graph rebuild. When bound to MFX, this tool only accepts sidechainFrom; sampler/MIDI/instrument config is PAM/Cell1-only.

midiNote.description: MIDI trigger note for the cell.

varispeed.description: Varispeed mode (pitch = speed) vs independent pitch shift.

polyRootNote.description: Root note for poly pitch calculation. In Slice Keymap mode this is the key that triggers slice 1.

sliceKeymapMode.description: Slice Keymap mode: incoming MIDI notes select slices by index instead of pitch (polyRootNote -> slice 1, +1 semitone -> slice 2, ...), each at its native pitch. Works in poly (polyphonic slice play) and mono (each new note chokes the previous slice). Requires the cell's sample to be sliced; notes outside the slice range are silent. The slice lane is ignored while this is on. 0=off, 1=on.

sliceTriggerLength.description: Slice playback length when sliceKeymapMode=1: 0=Boundary (stop at the next slice edge), 1=Sample End (play to end of sample), 2=Note Off (sustain until key release; requires the cell to be in Gate mode).

scaleName.description: Scale name for pitch sequencer / note quantization ('chromatic' = no filter). An out-of-vocabulary string would silently play as chromatic while junk persists into the preset, so the name is validated.

quantScale.description: Pitch quantize scale when pitchMode=2 (Pitch Shift Quantize) or 3 (Varispeed Quantize): 0=Chromatic, 1=Major, 2=Minor, 3=Penta Maj, 4=Penta Min, 5=Dorian, 6=Mixolydian, 7=Blues, 8=Harm Min, 9=Phrygian. Order locked to QuantScale in modules/helpers/Scale.h.

quantRoot.description: Pitch quantize root when pitchMode=2 (Pitch Shift Quantize) or 3 (Varispeed Quantize): 0=C, 1=C#, ..., 11=B.

grainDensity.description: Cloud stretch grain density when stretchMode=1.

grainWindow.description: Cloud stretch grain envelope when stretchMode=1: 0=Hann, 1=Tukey, 2=Welch, 3=Punch, 4=Swell.

spread.description: Cloud stretch grain spread (0..100) when stretchMode=1.

chaos.description: Cloud stretch grain chaos (0..100) when stretchMode=1.

sidechainFrom.description: Sidechain compressor source. null=no sidechain, 0=external audio input, 1-8=cell output. Auto-enables the cell's compressor when set to a non-null value.

tools.name: set_cell_mute
tools.description: Mute, unmute, solo, or unsolo a cell in the mixer — the real channel mute/solo, cutting the whole channel (source + all effect tails) rather than pulling the volume fader down. Soloing a cell silences every other non-soloed cell until unsoloed. cell{N}_mute / cell{N}_solo are live-polled state variables (no graph rebuild). Prefer this over set_parameter volume -60 when the user says mute, unmute, solo, unsolo, isolate, or 'just this cell'.

mute.description: Mute (true) or unmute (false) the cell's channel.

solo.description: Solo (true) or unsolo (false) the cell — solo silences all other non-soloed cells.

tools.name: set_master_effects
tools.description: Configure the master bus Punch compressor, Limiter, and Tape colour. The Punch compressor is a musical bus compressor — use it for glue and pump. The Limiter is a zero-latency brickwall safety stage (enable/disable only). Check results with get_master_analysis (keep tp <= -1 dBTP, PSR >= 8 in the loudest section). The Tape is a vintage-tape coloration stage (ADAA tanh/asymmetric saturation + HF compression + wow/flutter), the single biggest lever for lo-fi / dusty / 'pushed' master character (hip-hop, lo-fi, Memphis, dub). Pass enabled flags to toggle each on/off. Pass parameters to shape the sound. For pumpy beats: enable punch, set threshold around -18 to -12 dB, fast attack (0.1-0.5ms), medium release (80-200ms), ratio 4-8, autoMakeup true. For lo-fi/Memphis/dusty glue: tapeEnabled=1, tapeMode=1 (Lo-Fi), masterTapeDrive 0.55-0.7, masterTapeTone -0.4..-0.1 (darker), masterTapeWear 0.5-0.7 (wow/flutter). Squeeze (masterSqueeze*) is the 3-band up/down density stage between Punch and Tape — for dense modern-electronic masters set masterSqueezeEnabled=1 with masterSqueezeDepth 0.2-0.4; it lifts quiet detail and limits loud bands per band (a character stage, not glue — Punch stays the glue). NOTE: the Tape and Squeeze stages require a PAM build that ships them (flat state keys, not manifest params). On older builds these keys are ignored.

masterCompOutTrim.description: Output trim in dB (default 0) — the Punch panel's Makeup knob (post-compression level, separate from masterCompMakeupGain).

masterCompMix.description: Punch parallel dry/wet (0-1, default 1 = fully compressed).

masterTapeDrive.description: Tape drive / saturation amount (0-1, default 0.5). Higher = more harmonic grit + HF compression ('push it harder → it gets duller').

masterTapeTone.description: Tape tone tilt (-1 dark .. 0 flat .. +1 bright, default 0). Go negative for dusty/lo-fi.

masterTapeMode.description: Tape character: 0=Clean (gentle tanh), 1=Lo-Fi (most degradation, dusty), 2=Amp (hard asymmetric drive), 3=Studio (Jiles-Atherton magnetic hysteresis — the deep hi-fi machine, no wow/hiss). Default 0.

masterTapeWear.description: Tape wear: wow/flutter pitch drift + age (0-1, default 0.5). Raise for warble/sag.

masterWidthEnabled.description: Enable the stereo utility (width + elliptical bass-mono).

masterInputTrim.description: Master input trim in dB (gain staging into the chain; default 0).

masterEqTilt.description: Tilt in dB at the extremes around a 650 Hz pivot (+ = brighter; the coarse tonal-balance lever).

masterWidth.description: Stereo width (0=mono, 1=unity, 2=double side; default 1). Check corr in get_master_analysis after widening.

masterBassMonoFreq.description: Elliptical bass-mono corner Hz; < 20 = off. Engage (~100-120) when corrLow < +0.7.

masterClipEnabled.description: Enable the oversampled soft clipper (post-Tape, pre-Limiter). Adds 23 samples of reported latency while on.

masterClipDrive.description: Clipper drive dB (default 0). Staging guidance: the clipper shaves the sharpest 2-3 dB so the limiter works 1-2 dB.

masterClipMode.description: Clipper transfer: 0=Smooth (knee-tanh), 1=Silicon diode (hard knee), 2=Germanium diode (earlier, softer knee), 3=LED (higher knee). Diode modes are exact antiparallel-pair solves, ADAA at the 2x rate. Default 0.

masterIronEnabled.description: Enable the console/transformer iron colour stage (post-Tape, pre-Clipper; zero latency).

masterIronDrive.description: Iron drive dB (default 0). Level-compensated — drive adds colour, not loudness.

masterIronAmount.description: Transformer (magnetizing-branch) depth 0..1 — LF-concentrated saturation, the 'iron' signature (default 0.5).

masterSqueezeEnabled.description: Enable Squeeze — a 3-band upward+downward compressor (post-Punch, pre-Tape; zero latency). The character (88/2500 Hz splits, thresholds, ratios) is baked; Depth is the main lever.

masterSqueezeDepth.description: Squeeze depth 0..1 (default 0.3): scales the applied per-band gain toward the full character — a density control, NOT a dry/wet. 0.15-0.3 densifies a master; 0.6+ is the aggressive pumped sound.

masterSqueezeTime.description: Squeeze time multiplier on all band attack+release (0.1 fast .. 10 slow, default 1).

masterSqueezeTone.description: Squeeze tone: bipolar low<->high band tilt, ±6 dB at the extremes (default 0).

masterSqueezeInGain.description: Squeeze input gain dB (default 0) — drives program into the fixed thresholds (more In = more of everything).

masterSqueezeUpAmount.description: Squeeze upward-branch trim 0..1.5 (default 1). 0 disables the upward lift (downward-only multiband).

masterSqueezeDownAmount.description: Squeeze downward-branch trim 0..1.5 (default 1). 0 disables the downward limiting (pure upward lift).

masterSqueezeUpCapDb.description: Squeeze upward max-boost clamp dB (default 12) — bounds how far quiet material (tails, noise floor) is lifted.

masterLoudnessAutoReset.description: Loudness meter auto-reset on host transport start (default 1). 0 keeps measurements running across transport stops.

masterEqBells.description: The 4 parametric bells in order (defaults 200/700/2000/5000 Hz). Pass null-ish entries to skip a band.

dyn.description: Dynamic option: the band's gain rides the in-band level.

dynRange.description: Dynamic range dB (negative ducks when loud — de-harsh; default -3).

tools.name: set_drum_synth
tools.description: Select and shape a cell's built-in drum-synth 'machine' — a real-time synthesized voice that sums into the cell alongside (or instead of) its sample. 19 engines: Off, Kick, Snare, HiHat, Clap, Tom, FM, Cymbal, Cowbell, 808, Shaker, Rim, Conga, Bell, Pluck, Zap, Wave, Chaos, Stab. The 808 engine is a tuned long-glide sub that plays as a chromatic bassline (drive it with a pitch lane + pitch-quantize) — ideal for 808 sub-bass, trap, Memphis. Use a cell with NO sample for a pure synth voice, or layer over a sample. Each engine reinterprets the 8 generic params (p1..p8); pass only the ones you want to nuance. First activation seeds every slot from the engine's musical defaults. On a switch between two active engines, only slots you had moved off their default travel, and they carry the engine VALUE (re-mapped through the destination's own range), so Kick Decay 0.41 becomes Stab Decay 0.336 — the same 198 ms. Untouched slots, and slots whose label or unit has no counterpart, take the destination's default. Per-engine p-labels: Kick=[Tune,P.Depth,P.Decay,Decay,Click,Drive,Tone,Wave]; Snare=[Tune,Noise,Decay,N.Decay,N.Tone,P.Depth,P.Decay,Drive]; HiHat=[Tune,Decay,Tone,Metal,Noise]; Clap=[Freq,Spread,Decay,Reso,Drive]; Tom=[Tune,P.Depth,Decay,Tone,Noise,Drive,P.Decay]; FM=[Tune,Ratio,FM Amt,Decay,FM Decay,F.Back,Drive]; Cymbal=[Tune,Decay,Tone,Metal,Sizzle]; Cowbell=[Tune,Decay,Ratio,Tone,Drive]; 808=[Tune,P.Depth,P.Time,Decay,Saturate,Click,Tone]; Shaker=[Tune,Color,Onset,Decay,Rattle,Tone]; Rim=[Tune,Ring,Decay,Partial,Snap,Drive]; Conga=[Tune,Slap,Decay,Partial,Tone,Skin,Drive]; Bell=[Tune,Ratio,FM Amt,Decay,Inharm,Strike,Tone]; Pluck=[Tune,Sustain,Damp,Excite,Bright,Drive,Decay]; Zap=[Tune,Sweep,S.Time,Decay,Timbre,Noise,Drive,Tone]; Wave=[Tune,Position,P.Env,Decay,Bright,Fold,Drive,Draw]; Chaos=[Tune,Chaos,Decay,Tone,Drive,Noise]; Stab=[Tune,Shape,Width,Chord,Detune,Decay,Tone,Drive]. NOTE: requires a PAM build with drum synth (manifest.drumSynth.enabled). This headless tool is product-gated, not gated by the UI-only drumSynthEnabled preference. On products without it, this tool returns a product error instead of writing inert synth keys.

engine.description: Engine name. 'Off' disables the synth voice (sample-only cell).

p1.description: Param 1 (engine-specific; usually Tune). Overrides the engine default.

tools.name: set_drum_synth_wave
tools.description: Set the custom single-cycle waveform for a cell's drum-synth WAVE engine (engine #16). Provide 2–16 breakpoints { t, v, tension } (t = phase 0..1, v = amplitude 0..1 with 0.5 the zero-crossing centre, tension −1..+1 with 0 = linear). PAM bakes them into a DC-removed, peak-normalized single cycle that the Wave engine's Draw param (p8) crossfades against the factory bank. Only the Wave engine reads it — select 'Wave' via set_drum_synth and raise Draw (p8) to hear it. Runs in the WebView (the curve transform is single-sourced there), so PAM's window must be OPEN. Needs PAM ≥ 1.13.0.

points.description: 2–16 breakpoints defining the single cycle, ordered left→right by t.

tools.name: add_param_seq
tools.description: Add a parameter sequencer (step modulation) targeting any modulatable parameter. Generates rhythmic value changes synced to transport. Steps are normalized 0-1 values. If a paramSeq already exists for this paramId, it is replaced.

sequence.description: Step values (0-1). Defaults to 16 steps of 0.5.

tools.name: update_param_seq
tools.description: Update an existing parameter sequencer's step values or properties. Use add_param_seq first if no paramSeq exists for this paramId.

tools.name: remove_param_seq
tools.description: Remove a parameter sequencer for the given paramId.

tools.name: normalize_sample
tools.description: Normalize a cell's sample to peak amplitude (non-destructive).

tools.name: gain_sample
tools.description: Apply a gain in decibels to a cell's sample and render it into a new file (offline, destructive). Positive values make it louder, negative quieter; boosting past 0 dBFS clips. The original library file is left unchanged, so the edit can be undone by reloading the source sample.

gainDb.description: Gain in decibels (e.g. 3 = +3 dB louder, -6 = 6 dB quieter).

tools.name: export_audio
tools.description:
Render and export audio from the current preset to a WAV file in PAM's Exports folder. Waits for completion. Default mode renders the looping preset for `bars` bars at the current BPM. Set `mode` to bounce stems or the whole Song Mode arrangement.

Modes: 'main' (full mix, default) · 'individual' (one cell solo, needs cellId) · 'all-cells' / 'selected-cells' (per-cell stems, the latter needs selectedCellIds) · 'per-bus' (per output bus) · 'song-mode' (the Song Mode timeline).

NOTE on 'song-mode': the offline bounce applies EVERY section on its anchor (PAM ≥ 1.5.7 with offline song export; older builds render only the first section). Wall-clock sources (Magenta/Notochord) render silent offline — use the `export_song` tool's live strategy for those.

bars.description: Bars to render (ignored for 'song-mode', which derives length from the timeline).

cellId.description: Render only a specific cell in solo (implies mode 'individual'). Omit for full mix.

mode.description: Export mode. Defaults to 'main' (or 'individual' when cellId is set).

selectedCellIds.description: For mode 'selected-cells': cells to bounce as stems.

tools.name: arm_looper_track
tools.description: Arm or disarm a looper track for recording. Arming alone does not start recording — call start_looper_recording afterwards (or use arm_and_record).

armed.description: true to arm, false to disarm.

tools.name: set_looper_track
tools.description: Update one or more per-track looper fields (mute, overdub mode, reverse, pitch, warp, capture source, level). Pass only the fields you want to change.

solo.description: Solo / unsolo (toggle others off if true).

overdubMode.description: Overdub vs replace behavior on next recording.

sourceCell.description: Capture source: 0 = external input, 1-8 = cell output. (UI-side inverted vs captureSource.)

autoSelect.description: Enable auto-select cycling of clip regions.

recordedBpm.description: Override the recorded BPM for the track (0 = unset).

tools.name: clear_looper_track
tools.description: Clear the recorded clip and any selection state for a looper track. Does NOT delete the audio file from disk (the C++ side handles file cleanup separately).

tools.name: set_looper_track_selection
tools.description: Set the in/out selection (in loop-normalized 0..1 coordinates) for a looper track.

tools.name: start_looper_recording
tools.description: Queue a looper recording. Recording starts at the next bar boundary when the transport is playing, or immediately when stopped. Tracks must be armed first (or pass armedCellIds to arm + record). Each track's captureSource: 0 = cell output (post-FX), 1 = external input.

trackMetadata.description: Per-track metadata. Defaults: replace mode, cell-output source. Pass existingClipPaths to enable overdub on a prior layer.

tools.name: stop_looper_recording
tools.description: Stop or cancel the active looper recording session.

tools.name: capture_looper_now
tools.description: Capture audio that is already in the rolling buffer (requires looper_always_listen=true). Fires immediately if the buffer holds enough audio for the requested bars; otherwise arms and waits.

mode.description: 'match' = follow each track's overdubMode, 'overdub' = layer on existing, 'replace' = overwrite.

tools.name: load_audio_to_looper_track
tools.description: Load an audio file directly into a looper track (skips recording). File must be a wav/mp3/aif/flac under the PAM base path or absolute.

tools.name: request_looper_warp
tools.description: Render an offline warp for a looper track's clip at the current host BPM. Result lands in state.loopers[cellId].warpedClipPath when ready.

tools.name: looper_settings
tools.description: Configure looper-wide behavior: always-listen rolling buffer, input-latency compensation.

alwaysListen.description: Keep capturing audio into a rolling buffer (required for capture_looper_now).

latencyCompAuto.description: Auto-compensate for input latency (defaults ON for external input).

latencyCompApplyToCells.description: Apply latency comp also when capture source is a cell output.

tools.name: looper_variation
tools.description: Manage looper variation slots (clip-set snapshots). Operations: 'apply' (immediate), 'queue' (bar-synced), 'cancel', 'clear', 'setCurrent', 'save' (snapshot current looper state into the slot).

data.description: For 'save': the looper variation snapshot (object). Pass null to clear instead.

tools.name: looper_variation_sync
tools.description: Configure how looper variation switches synchronize to bar boundaries.

tools.name: queue_variation
tools.description: Schedule a global variation switch on the next bar boundary. For an immediate switch, use load_variation instead. Optionally morph into the new section over the bars before the boundary (song mode / an already-engaged queued-flip window only; a from-idle flip hard-switches).

morphBars.description: Pre-anchor morph window in bars for this flip (PAM >= 1.19.3). Omit = hard switch.

morphMode.description: Morph style: 'param' glides continuous params (default); 'mix' equal-power blends the two sections; 'seq' adds a staged pattern dissolve to the glide (old notes lose trigger probability as new notes gain it); 'all' runs glide + dissolve + blend together; 'auto' lets the engine pick — mix when the sections differ in graph topology (samples, synth engines, routing) or when nothing can glide, param otherwise (PAM >= 1.19.4; seq/all on older builds run param).

transition.description: Advanced transition settings for this flip (PAM >= 1.20.0): pattern policy for a seq/all morph, blend gain law for a mix/all morph, and the outgoing section's tail. Omitted fields keep the defaults (dissolve, equalPower, fade).

tools.name: cancel_queued_variation
tools.description: Cancel a pending bar-synced variation switch.

tools.name: update_variations
tools.description: Replace the entire 8-slot variations table with a new array. Each entry is a JSON-stringified variation snapshot (or null for an empty slot). Most agents should prefer save_variation for individual slots.

variations.description: Array of 8 entries (JSON string or null).

tools.name: variation_hold
tools.description: 'Hold while note pressed' mode for variations. Use this to map MIDI notes to momentary variation switches that revert when the note releases.

allNotesOff.description: Force-release any held trigger notes (useful after a stuck MIDI note).

bindings.description: Per-variation-slot MIDI bindings (slot 0..7). Array is padded with unassigned slots if shorter than 8.

tools.name: trigger_midi_cc
tools.description: Send a MIDI Control Change message into PAM's MIDI router. Maps to any MIDI-learned parameter or looper/variation CC bindings.

tools.name: trigger_midi_program_change
tools.description: Send a MIDI Program Change message (e.g. for preset switching).

tools.name: midi_recording
tools.description: Control live MIDI recording into the active sequencer. Ops: 'start' (optional opts), 'stop' (with commit flag), 'setOverdub', 'removeNote'.

tools.name: update_modulation
tools.description: Apply a delta to a modulation source: LFO, Envelope, Vary, Macro, ParamSeq config, ParamSeq sequence data, or the Free Sequencer master pattern. The payload is type-specific; see modulation update flows in interop.ts (applyLfoUpdate / updateEnvelope / etc.). Use add_modulation to first attach a source to a target — then this tool to edit it.

payload.description: Update payload object. Shape depends on type: lfo expects { index, rate?, depth?, shape?, customCurve?, target? }, envelope expects matrix entry edits, paramSeqSequence expects { id, steps[] }, freeSeqSequence expects { sequence: number[] } (the master step contour every free-mode ParamSeq follows), etc.

tools.name: song_mode
tools.description:
Control PAM's song mode (timeline of variation/preset sections). Ops: 'setArrangement', 'get', 'assignVx', 'setSequence', 'clear', 'toggle', 'setLoopPoints', 'toggleLoop', 'setCrossfadeMs', 'setPlayhead'.

PREFER 'setArrangement' (PAM ≥ 1.5.7, window open): it authors real Song Mode grid nodes from a `sections` list, with an optional weighted `connections` graph. The result is visible/editable in the UI, and each section can pin a VX (visual) variation slot via `vxVariationIndex` (omit = visuals follow the section's audio slot 1:1; see the vx_variation tool), optionally inside a specific VX scene via `vxScenePath` (the .vxpreset loads before the section plays, so sections can pull visuals from different scenes). A section can also carry `morphBars`/`morphCurve`/`morphMode` to glide the incoming variation's continuous params over the bars before its boundary (PAM >= 1.19.3), and an advanced `transition` spec (PAM >= 1.19.6 — authored metadata; see the field description). 'get' reads the arrangement back (nodes, compiled steps with the VX scene+slot each recalls, total bars, and each cable's `resolvedTransition` — the effective transition after inheritance and capability coercion, e.g. preset destinations report param); 'assignVx' re-pins one section's VX slot (and optional scene) after authoring.

'setSequence' is the older HEADLESS raw-step path (works with the window closed): steps land in the C++ player but carry no grid nodes, so the UI can't edit them and VX can only follow 1:1 by audio slot.

sections.description: For 'setArrangement': section list. Without `connections`, sections play in order.

variationIndex.description: Audio variation slot 0-7 this section plays. With presetPath set, this selects the variation INSIDE that preset's own bank — the two compose, they are not mutually exclusive.

bars.description: Section length in bars (default: auto from longest pattern).

muted.description: Pass through without an audio trigger.

presetPath.description: Cross-preset section: at this section's boundary the song switches to THIS preset file, playing its variations[variationIndex] slot. With lanePresetSections on (PAM >= 1.20.1) it transitions exactly like a variation section (prepared off the audible path, full morph family); otherwise the legacy in-place load applies.

label.description: Section label shown on the grid node (e.g. 'Intro', 'Hook').

morphBars.description: Pre-anchor morph window in bars for the transition INTO this section — continuous params glide to the new values, landing at the boundary (PAM >= 1.19.3). 0 = explicit hard switch (never morph, ignores the song's default); omit to inherit the default. Values in (0, 0.25) clamp up to 0.25.

morphCurve.description: Morph glide easing; default ease. Ignored without morphBars.

morphMode.description: Morph realization; default auto — the engine picks mix when the sections differ in graph topology (samples, synth engines, routing) or when nothing can glide, param otherwise (PAM >= 1.19.4; older builds run param). 'param' glides continuous params; 'mix' DJ-blends stems; 'seq' adds a staged pattern dissolve to the glide; 'all' runs glide + dissolve + blend (seq/all on older builds run param). Ignored without morphBars.

transition.description: Advanced transition spec (PAM >= 1.19.6; live engine from PAM >= 1.20.0): pattern.policy ('dissolve' prob-morphs events, 'wipe' replaces them at a moving frontier, 'cells' hands whole cells over in ascending order), audio.mixLaw ('equalPower' default, 'equalGain' for correlated sections, 'correlation' auto-adapts), audio.tail ('fade' default, 'cut', 'ring' lets voices/FX decay up to tailMaxBars), phase ('reset'/'continue' overrides the song's Reset Phase per cable), window.patternCurve/mixCurve (per-domain easing; patternCurve defaults linear). Runs on variation sections + queued flips, and on preset destinations when the lanePresetSections setting is on (PAM >= 1.20.1 — the dual-lane preset section pipeline; with it off, preset destinations coerce to a param glide). Offline bounces coerce ring→fade, blend→hard switch. 'get' reads back each cable's resolvedTransition (effective values after inheritance and capability coercion) and lastMorphResolution (the engine's latest AUTO decision + reason).

vxVariationIndex.description: VX variation slot recalled while this section plays (omit = follow the audio slot).

vxScenePath.description: VX scene (.vxpreset path) whose slots vxVariationIndex indexes into — loaded before the section plays, so sections can pull visuals from different scenes. Requires vxVariationIndex; omit = the live scene's slots.

connections.description: For 'setArrangement': optional cable graph. Multiple cables may leave or enter a section. Each cable may carry its own morphBars/morphCurve/morphMode/transition.

probability.description: Branch probability (0-1). Sibling routes normalize to 100%.

morphBars.description: Per-cable morph window in bars — overrides the destination section's morphBars for THIS cable only (branching arrangements can give each incoming cable its own window). 0 = hard switch; omit to use the section value / song default.

morphCurve.description: Per-cable morph easing; overrides the destination section's morphCurve.

morphMode.description: Per-cable morph realization; overrides the destination section's morphMode. Same modes as the section field, incl. 'seq' (pattern dissolve) and 'all' (glide + dissolve + blend).

transition.description: Per-cable Advanced transition spec (PAM >= 1.19.6; live engine from PAM >= 1.20.0): pattern.policy ('dissolve' prob-morphs events, 'wipe' replaces them at a moving frontier, 'cells' hands whole cells over in ascending order), audio.mixLaw ('equalPower' default, 'equalGain' for correlated sections, 'correlation' auto-adapts), audio.tail ('fade' default, 'cut', 'ring' lets voices/FX decay up to tailMaxBars), phase ('reset'/'continue' overrides the song's Reset Phase per cable), window.patternCurve/mixCurve (per-domain easing; patternCurve defaults linear). Runs on variation sections + queued flips, and on preset destinations when the lanePresetSections setting is on (PAM >= 1.20.1 — the dual-lane preset section pipeline; with it off, preset destinations coerce to a param glide). Offline bounces coerce ring→fade, blend→hard switch. 'get' reads back each cable's resolvedTransition (effective values after inheritance and capability coercion) and lastMorphResolution (the engine's latest AUTO decision + reason).

defaultTransition.description: For 'setArrangement': song-level advanced transition defaults inherited by cables without their own `transition`; null clears. Advanced transition spec (PAM >= 1.19.6; live engine from PAM >= 1.20.0): pattern.policy ('dissolve' prob-morphs events, 'wipe' replaces them at a moving frontier, 'cells' hands whole cells over in ascending order), audio.mixLaw ('equalPower' default, 'equalGain' for correlated sections, 'correlation' auto-adapts), audio.tail ('fade' default, 'cut', 'ring' lets voices/FX decay up to tailMaxBars), phase ('reset'/'continue' overrides the song's Reset Phase per cable), window.patternCurve/mixCurve (per-domain easing; patternCurve defaults linear). Runs on variation sections + queued flips, and on preset destinations when the lanePresetSections setting is on (PAM >= 1.20.1 — the dual-lane preset section pipeline; with it off, preset destinations coerce to a param glide). Offline bounces coerce ring→fade, blend→hard switch. 'get' reads back each cable's resolvedTransition (effective values after inheritance and capability coercion) and lastMorphResolution (the engine's latest AUTO decision + reason).

stepIndex.description: For 'assignVx': compiled step index (alternative to nodeId).

vxIndex.description: For 'assignVx': VX slot 0-7, or null to clear (follow the audio slot).

vxScenePath.description: For 'assignVx': pin the scene (.vxpreset path) vxIndex indexes into (requires vxIndex; null/'' clears the pin → the live scene's slots; omit = keep the node's current pin).

steps.description: For 'setSequence': raw step list (headless path; prefer 'setArrangement').

startPositionPPQ.description: Start position in PPQ (4 PPQ = 1 bar at 4/4).

presetPath.description: If non-empty, load this preset instead of switching variation.

ppq.description: For 'setPlayhead': PPQ position to scrub to.

tools.name: export_song
tools.description:
Bounce the full Song Mode arrangement — the 'render my whole track' button. Set up the arrangement first with the `song_mode` tool (prefer op setArrangement), then call this.

Strategies:
• 'live' + includeVideo:true — full A/V render: plays the arrangement in real time, films the VX scene (VX variation follow runs live, so per-section visuals land exactly as assigned) and muxes the master mix into a video file. Needs PAM ≥ 1.5.7 with the window OPEN and at least one VX layer.
• 'live' without cellId — bar-synced audio WAV via the same WebView Song Export (lands in VX/Resamples; window must be open, PAM ≥ 1.5.7). No destination cell consumed.
• 'live' with cellId — legacy headless master-mix capture into an empty cell (works with the window closed on PAM ≥ 1.5.0). The captured WAV also lands in PAM's Resamples folder.
• 'offline' — the DETERMINISTIC multi-section bounce (PAM ≥ 1.5.7 with offline song export): every variation section applies sample-accurately on its anchor; renders faster than realtime with no bar cap. Audio-only works headless (window closed); includeVideo runs the offline video pump with per-section VX recalls (window open, WebCodecs). Caveats: preset-path steps hold the previous section's sound (pending), and wall-clock sources (Magenta, Notochord, camera layers) cannot render offline — use 'live' for those.

Live paths render in REAL TIME (a 90 s song takes ~90 s) and cap at 64 bars per capture. Verify audio results with get_audio_info (resolve cell captures against the Resamples location from get_default_locations).

bars.description: Total arrangement length in bars (the full timeline). Required for 'live'.

cellId.description: For legacy headless 'live': empty destination cell for the bounced clip. Omit to use the WebView Song Export (window open).

includeVideo.description: Film the VX scene alongside the audio and mux to video (window open, VX layers required).

name.description: Output name for WebView Song Export renders (default 'Song').

normalize.description: Normalize the captured audio (WebView Song Export paths).

encoderId.description: Recording encoder preset for includeVideo (e.g. mp4-h264).

bitDepth.description: Bit depth (16 or 24; legacy cell-capture + offline paths).

tailBars.description: For legacy cell-capture 'live': extra bars captured after the arrangement end for tails.

tools.name: set_metronome
tools.description: Toggle PAM's internal metronome on or off.

tools.name: analyze_sample_tempo
tools.description: Run BPM detection and transient/slice analysis on an audio file. Result is dispatched asynchronously into PAM's state — fetch it via get_state after a short delay (~100-500ms). Use this before resample_sample_to_bpm if you don't already know the source BPM.

maxSlices.description: Cap on number of detected slices.

tools.name: get_sample_peaks
tools.description: Read a sample's waveform peak data for display/analysis. Returns an array of min/max peaks at the requested resolution. Searches VFS first, then loads from disk.

samplesPerPixel.description: Resolution control — if set, peaks downsampled to ~ numSamples/samplesPerPixel bins (clamped 64..8192). Default 0 = 8192 pixels.

tools.name: preview_slice
tools.description: Audition a single slice of a cell's sample.

tools.name: resample_sample_to_bpm
tools.description: Time-stretch a cell's sample to the current project BPM (or a target BPM). Non-destructive — use restore_original_sample to revert.

sourceBpm.description: Source BPM. If omitted, PAM uses the analyzed/declared BPM in state.

targetBpm.description: Target BPM (defaults to current project BPM).

tools.name: restore_original_sample
tools.description: Revert a cell's sample to its un-edited source (undoes resample / trim / etc.).

tools.name: build_sample_chain
tools.description: Concatenate multiple audio files into one chained sample loaded onto a cell. Useful for sample-flip kits.

tools.name: export_slice
tools.description: Export a single slice of a cell's sample as a standalone WAV.

tools.name: live_resample
tools.description:
Capture PAM's audio graph output into a cell as a new sample, in real time. Ops: 'start' / 'stop'. Transport MUST be playing for the capture to produce audio. Because the capture runs live, Song Mode section changes, modulation, and variation switches are all captured faithfully — this is the building block for full-track / Song Mode bounces (see export_song).

`source` selects what to record: 'cell' (the destination cell's own output), 'input' (PAM's audio input), or 'fullmix' (the whole master mix — use this to bounce the entire arrangement).

cellId.description: For 'start': destination cell the captured clip lands in. Use an empty/scratch cell for a full-mix bounce.

bars.description: For 'start': capture length in bars (max 64; the capture also stops on the 'stop' op).

source.description: For 'start': capture source. 'fullmix' records the entire master output (the whole song).

normalize.description: For 'start': peak-normalize the captured clip after recording.

finalize.description: For 'stop': finalize the captured clip (false discards).

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: List plugins that have been discovered by PAM's scanner (VST3, AudioUnit, and CLAP). Returns `plugins` (each: name, manufacturer, format, category, fileOrIdentifier, isInstrument, version) and `blocklist` (paths the scanner marked unsafe). Use this before `load_plugin` to find a valid `path` + `format`. If the list is empty, call `scan_plugins` first. Note: PAM's MCP hosts plugins in the per-cell instrument slot only — FX-side hosting is not exposed yet.

isInstrument.description: If true, only instruments; false, only effects.

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the plugin name.

tools.name: scan_plugins
tools.description: Trigger an async scan for VST3, AudioUnit, and CLAP plugins. Returns immediately — poll `get_plugin_scan_status` for progress and call `list_plugins` once `isScanning` is false. Without `searchPaths`, scans default OS plugin folders. Supplied `searchPaths` must live under PAM's approved plugin roots (/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/{VST3,Components,CLAP} or their ~ equivalents on macOS; C:/Program Files/Common Files/{VST3,CLAP} on Windows).

searchPaths.description: Folders to scan. Must be inside an approved plugin root. Leave empty to use OS defaults (/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/* on macOS, etc.).

blocklist.description: File paths or identifiers the scanner should skip.

tools.name: cancel_plugin_scan
tools.description: Cancel the in-flight plugin scan. Safe to call even if no scan is running.

tools.name: get_plugin_scan_status
tools.description: Read the latest plugin scan progress. Returns `isScanning`, `format`, `currentPath`, `fraction` (0..1), `elapsedMs`, `isStall` (true when the in-flight plugin hasn't returned in 2s), and `updatedAtMs`. Poll while a scan is running.

tools.name: list_loaded_plugins
tools.description: List plugins currently hosted in PAM cells (instrument slot only — FX-side hosting is not exposed). Each entry: cellId, name, manufacturer, format, path, isInstrument, bypassed, and the plugin's full param list (index, name, label, value, defaultValue). Use the param `index` with `set_plugin_param`.

tools.name: load_plugin
tools.description: Load a hosted plugin (VST3, AudioUnit, or CLAP) into a cell's instrument slot. Blocks until the plugin probes + instantiates (can take seconds for heavy plugins) and returns success or the underlying error. `path` must be a `fileOrIdentifier` returned by a previous `list_plugins` call in this session.

uniqueId.description: Optional type disambiguator for multi-type bundles (one .vst3 exposing several plugin types, e.g. Serum2.vst3 = instrument + FX). Pass the uniqueId from the list_plugins entry you want. Absent → PAM prefers the instrument type at that path.

name.description: Optional type name disambiguator (the list_plugins `name`), used when uniqueId is unavailable.

tools.name: unload_plugin
tools.description: Unload the hosted plugin from a cell. No-op if no plugin is loaded there.

tools.name: set_plugin_param
tools.description: Set a parameter on a hosted plugin by cell + parameter index. Value is normalized 0..1. Use `list_loaded_plugins` to find param indices and names. This is the dedicated path for hosted plugin params — `set_parameters` won't reach them. Targets the cell's instrument-slot plugin only.

tools.name: set_plugin_bypass
tools.description: Toggle bypass on the hosted plugin in a cell (instrument slot). Bypassed plugins are silenced; the cell sampler still plays in parallel.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Merge a partial settings delta into PAM's plugin settings (the Settings panel state) and apply it live. Returns the full merged settings object so you can discover available keys. This is the only way to flip experimental-feature gates from an agent. Common boolean keys: experimentalMode, experimentalPluginHost, experimentalMcpBridge. To enable the plugin host, set BOTH experimentalMode:true AND the specific sub-flag (e.g. experimentalPluginHost:true) in one call. Set drumSynthEnabled:false to hide its UI without muting loaded synths. Other keys include UI/library preferences — call get_state or inspect the returned object for the current set.

settings.description: Partial settings object to merge. Example: { experimentalMode: true, experimentalPluginHost: true }

tools.name: configure_transport
tools.description: Configure transport behaviour beyond BPM (use set_bpm for tempo). Set the time signature, toggle host-sync (when off, preset/user BPM overrides the host), toggle external clock sync, mute the audio output (standalone), or release host-sync ownership for manual transport. All fields are optional — only the provided ones are applied.

hostSyncEnabled.description: When false, preset/user BPM overrides the host tempo.

externalClockSync.description: Sync the internal transport to external MIDI clock.

muteAudioOutput.description: Standalone only: mute the master output.

releaseHostSyncForManualTransport.description: When true, release host-sync ownership so the internal transport can be driven manually.

tools.name: get_audio_device_setup
tools.description: Get the standalone audio/MIDI device setup (sample rate, buffer size, available and active input/output devices). Returns null when running plugin-hosted (the DAW owns the device config). Use the device IDs/names from here with set_midi_io.

tools.name: set_audio_device
tools.description: Switch the active audio OUTPUT device by name (standalone only — plugin-hosted builds let the DAW own the device, and the call errors there). Use the exact name from get_audio_device_setup's device list. The usual reason to call this headlessly is routing PAM into a loopback device (BlackHole, Soundflower) so a capture run records audio. MIDI devices go through set_midi_io.

deviceName.description: Output device name exactly as listed by get_audio_device_setup.

tools.name: set_midi_io
tools.description: Select MIDI input/output devices (standalone). Use get_audio_device_setup to discover device IDs first. All fields optional.

inputDeviceIds.description: Enabled MIDI input device IDs (replaces the active set).

tools.name: set_midi_mapping
tools.description: Configure the global MIDI-controller mappings that trigger PAM actions: variation switch, preset change, looper record, live resample, VX video record toggle, and looper-variation switch. Set the enable flag, MIDI channel, CC number, preset source, or bar-sync for each target. One field per call.

target.description: Which action's mapping to configure. 'vxRecord' toggles VX video recording — requires the PAM window open (VX renders in the WebView).

field.description: Field to set. 'source' is preset-only; 'barSync' is variation/looperVariation-only; looper/resample/vxRecord have no source/barSync.

value.description: boolean for enabled/barSync; number for channel (1-16), ccNumber (0-127), or source.

tools.name: delete_preset
tools.description: Delete a user preset file from disk. Factory presets are protected and cannot be deleted. Use the relative path returned by list_presets.

tools.name: set_preset_factory_status
tools.description: Mark a preset as factory (read-only) or user (editable) on disk. Affects the factory flag and the file location.

tools.name: get_sample_usage
tools.description: Cross-reference samples and presets. mode 'presetUsesSamples' lists the samples a preset references; mode 'presetsUsingSample' lists presets that reference a given sample (or any sample under a folder).

path.description: Relative preset path (presetUsesSamples) or relative sample path (presetsUsingSample).

isFolder.description: presetsUsingSample only: treat 'path' as a folder and match any sample beneath it.

tools.name: repair_preset_samples
tools.description: Fix broken sample references in presets. mode 'fix' auto-relinks moved/renamed samples by searching the library (optionally scoped to one preset). mode 'rescan' re-audits a preset for still-missing samples and reports them. Useful after moving a sample library or importing presets from another machine.

presetPath.description: Relative preset path. Omit for 'fix' to scan all presets; omit for 'rescan' to audit the active preset.

tools.name: preview_sample
tools.description: Audition an audio file through PAM's native preview player without loading it into a cell. Pass filePath to start previewing; pass stop:true to stop the current preview.

filePath.description: Absolute or library-relative path to the audio file to preview.

stop.description: Stop the current preview instead of starting one.

tools.name: set_plugin_params
tools.description: Set multiple hosted-plugin parameters in one call (more efficient than set_plugin_param per value). Values are 0..1 normalized. Use list_loaded_plugins to discover paramIndex values. role defaults to 'instrument'.

values.description: Array of { paramIndex, value } where value is 0..1 normalized.

tools.name: skip_current_plugin_scan
tools.description: Skip (blocklist) the plugin currently being scanned and continue the scan. Use when a scan is stuck on a crashing/hanging plugin (poll get_plugin_scan_status to detect a stall).

tools.name: remove_plugin_from_blocklist
tools.description: Un-blocklist a plugin that was blocklisted after a failed/crashed scan so it can be scanned and loaded again. Pass the fileOrIdentifier as it appears in the blocklist (see list_plugins → blocklist).

fileOrIdentifier.description: The blocklisted plugin's file path or identifier.

instructions: PAM is an audio sampler plugin. Start design/read work with design_context (curated param cheat sheet) and get_design_overview (compact live snapshot) instead of full get_state or broad get_parameter_info; when you need detail, call get_state with section/keys/cellIds filters. When browsing samples, ALWAYS call get_default_locations first to discover the user's actual library paths — never guess paths like ~/Music/PAM. The sample library lives under ~/Library/Application Support/, NOT ~/Music/. Use the returned paths with list_samples. When loading samples, use load_sample with paths from list_samples. Transport must be playing for sequencer output. To enable experimental features (plugin host, AI engines) call update_settings with both experimentalMode:true AND the specific sub-flag (e.g. experimentalPluginHost:true). The standard Drum Synth UI follows drumSynthEnabled (default true); this preference does not mute synth audio. set_mfx_routing is the MFX cable patchbay and errors on PAM/Cell1; set_audio_device is standalone-only. Tools added in server version 1.7.0 — update_settings, configure_transport, get_audio_device_setup, set_midi_io, set_midi_mapping, delete_preset, set_preset_factory_status, get_sample_usage, repair_preset_samples, preview_sample, set_plugin_params, skip_current_plugin_scan, remove_plugin_from_blocklist — require PAM ≥ 1.7.0. VX video tools (get_video_state, video_command, add_video_layer, update_video_layer, remove_video_layer, apply_video_layout, add_video_fx, set_video_fx, remove_video_fx, bind_video_param, set_video_settings, set_video_layer_source) require PAM ≥ 1.8.0 AND PAM's window to be OPEN (the video engine renders in the WebView; there is no headless renderer). capture_ui, set_visual, set_drum_synth_wave, and randomize with target 'synth' are WebView-routed too and need the window open for the same reason. For audio-reactive control, note the visual audio-react params (visualWaveDisplace, etc.) are regular plugin params — drive them with set_parameters; layers/FX/bindings go through the video tools. When building a scene, call get_video_state first to learn layer/fx ids. AI model lifecycle tools (download_model, get_model_status, load_model, unload_model, delete_model, list_models; engines aigen|magenta|notochord) require PAM ≥ 1.9.0 plus the matching experimental flags; load/unload/delete can block for seconds — poll get_model_status rather than tight-looping. Earlier tool sets (looper, song mode, modulation edits, MIDI recording, sample analysis, live resample, variation scheduling, AI generation) require PAM ≥ 1.5.0. SONG WORKFLOW: author sections as variation slots (save_variation), arrange them with song_mode (op setArrangement authors real Song Mode grid nodes and can pin a VX variation slot per section via vxVariationIndex; op setSequence is the older headless raw-step path), manage visual variation slots with vx_variation (save/load/clear/fill — the VX siblings of save_variation), then bounce with export_song (includeVideo:true films the VX scene with variation follow live). song_mode setArrangement/get/assignVx, vx_variation, and export_song includeVideo are WebView-routed (window open, PAM ≥ 1.5.7). If a tool fails with "PAM build does not support 'X'", the connected plugin is older than this MCP server; the user must update PAM (updating the npm package alone is not enough). Tool annotations are accurate: readOnlyHint tools never mutate the plugin, destructiveHint tools discard user state (confirm intent before calling them). When several product instances run at once (PAM + MFX), select_instance chooses which one the live tools drive (PAM_BRIDGE_PRODUCT pins it at launch). Guided workflow prompts are available: build-a-beat, make-a-song, design-a-preset, mix-and-master, troubleshoot-bridge.
